{"claims":[{"claim_text":"U.S. and international policies must take into consideration the best interests of the Iraqi people.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Iraqi people desperately need financial and technical assistance that is not swallowed up by bureaucracy and no-bid contracts, but instead goes directly into grassroots organizations.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Iraqi people need to see the tangible benefits of reconstruction, including jobs, infrastructure, and services.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Iraqi people should receive the full benefits of their own oil production as quickly as possible, so as to rebuild their country and help themselves as individuals.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Receiving the full benefits of their own oil production will reduce the costs of security and reconstruction on the American taxpayer and the cost of gasoline to American consumers.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Iraqi people need to be able to communicate their concerns to international authorities without feeling they are being disrespected in their own country.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"America needs a massive training effort to build Iraqi security forces that can actually provide security for the Iraqi people.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Training of Iraqi security forces must be done in the field and on the job as well as in the classroom.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Units of Iraqi security forces cannot be put on the street without backup from international security forces.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The training of Iraqi security forces must be done in partnership with other nations.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Failure to create viable Iraqi security forces – military and police – means there is no successful exit for the U.S. and other nations.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
